title: Does Context Matter? CONTEXTUALJUDGEBENCH for Evaluating LLM-based Judges in Contextual Settings

bias_targets.methodology: Swapping the order of response pairs (Run 1 and Run 2) in the prompt and measuring the consistency of the judge's selection to determine if it unfairly prefers the first or second position.
Analyzing judge accuracy as a function of the token length difference between the positive and negative responses to identify if the judge inherently prefers longer, more verbose responses.
Comparing judge performance on answerable questions versus unanswerable questions to detect a tendency to inappropriately favor substantive responses over correct refusals.
